intro: Krueg Skullsplitter in Camp Mojache is startled to hear that you met tauren in Feralas, and more so on learning they are Grimtotem. Belgrom, one of Krueg's masters, has put a bounty on their kind. Krueg wants you to go back and bring him twenty Grimtotem horns.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: What!? You came across tauren in the area? You're joking! What did they look like!?
The Grimtotem clan! You found some of them? Belgrom, one of our masters, has an interest in their kind... He's even put a bounty on them.

You have to go back, adventurer. Go back and bring me their horns... Piles of them if you can. The Grimtotem are not to be trifled with or underestimated. Go back and slay them; let the rivers in Feralas run red with their dark blood.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Take my words seriously, adventurer, the Grimtotem clan is evil. If you've found their whereabouts, then it's up to you to return and strike the first blow against their clan... Before they can come into our own lands and raze our own villages, or pilfer our lands.

clips.title: Completion
paras: These are good horns, adventurer. Well done. I'll take these from you and be sure to tell Belgrom as soon as we return to Orgrimmar. You've helped me twice now, and for that, you have my mark. Perhaps in the future I can help you! Good luck to you.
